Academic Planning assignments supports learning how to be a successful Georgia Tech student, understanding your path to graduation, and identifying opportunities for academic enrichment. Assignments are announced in class and posted here as they are assigned.

Unless a deliverable says otherwise, submit your work to Canvas as a **PDF** by **11:59 PM ET** on the due date. Late work is not accepted.
